'''Spice Liqueur''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. It was a core ingredient of a [[Reactor Core (drink)|Reactor Core]], along with [[Blue Tonic]], as well as the [[Meltdown (cocktail)|Meltdown]] when mixed with [[Lum/Legends|Lum]].<ref name="GG9" />
